title: 4x Candy & Sweets Ferocious | 50/50 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Ferocious Candy & Sweet Flavors 50/50 Shortfill Bundle:
The ultimate mash-up of our favorite candy/sweet flavors ! This E-Liquid bundle package combines new and classic flavours. If you enjoy our Ferocious  candy vape liquids in a 50/50 blend, you’ll love this combination!
We’ve mixed our delicious, flavour-blasting sweet treat flavours in 120ml bottles to save money while stocking up on your absolute fave E-liquids; this is the ideal bundle for individuals who adore candy flavours worldwide.
Black Jack –
Delicious blend of sweet aniseed and liquorice with slight citrus undertones.
Perfect Pear Drop –
The great taste of classic pear sweets.
Strawberry Milkshake-
Fresh, cold milk and a big scoop of rich ice cream blended it all together with juicy, ripe strawberries.
Caramel Popcorn –
Sweet, light and beautifully buttery popcorn with a layer of sticky caramel topping.
Vape juice is made with a 50/50 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As this is a balanced vape juice, you will need a lower-powered device to vaporize it, like a pod device or vape starter kit. Our Ferocious Flavours Vape Liquids are available in a variety of quantities and intensities.
120ml Shortfill Bottles of 0mg 70/30 vape juice are available. If you want to add nicotine to your Shortfills, we have 100ml and 120ml bottles available with 3mg and 6mg nicotine strengths. We have 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg in stock, so you can just pop it into your tank and start vaping right away!
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (50%)
Propylene Glycol (50%)
VApoholic Flavoring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Black Jack Shortfill
1x Strawberry Milkshake Shortfill
1x Perfect Pear Drop Shortfill
1x Caramel Popcorn Shortfill
Specifications:

Highlights:
4x sweet flavoured Ferocious E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 50/50 mix for pod devices and vape starter kits
Perfect for flavoursome vaping
4 popular candy E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
